prior_summary: Absolute Cartesian TCP targets are learned in the observed bowl frame, making the bowl-centered carry, pour and righting motion equivariant to bowl displacement by construction while retaining robot and task relations in the condition.
applicable_conditions: Prefer with a reliable displaced bowl pose, a securely held source, a near-nominal rigid grasp transform and a reachable measured Panda configuration. It is also the nominal complete-trajectory default.
termination_guidance: Terminate or hand off only after at least ten particles are observed settled in the bowl, the source is approximately upright and held, and outbound motion has begun; nominal successor readiness is near index 1680 within the supervised [1460,1740) overlap.
limitations: Training does not vary the bowl and contains only nominal successful pours, so displacement benefit is structural and expected rather than observed. The model does not compensate a substantially different or slipping grasp and does not establish spill, collision or grasp-loss recovery. IK reachability and the fixed return goal remain dependencies.
